response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_abs_diff) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_abs_diff, g.avg_abs_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Snapshots with NULL corpeventprx form their own group (GROUP BY keeps NULL as a group). The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-group average differences. This includes the NULL group and ignores any group whose average is NULL.
A row with a NULL inholdpct or instownpct has a NULL difference and is skipped by the difference average. It is still counted in that group's anlycount average if its anlycount is present.
